bottleneck: Serial s1/s2 dependencies in an eight-byte unrolled loop; reduction only every 5552 bytes. CRC is a different function and must remain unchanged.

benchmark: Fixed-size packet, bulk, odd-boundary, large, real source-text checksums and compression/decompression workloads; zlib oracle, protected pages, sanitizers and upstream Catch suite.
challenges: Unsigned overflow bounds; compiler vectorization; tiny-call overhead; global VM variability. Known technique, library-specific opportunity; novelty uncertain.
estimated_cost: 2-4 CPU-min/trial; <1 GiB RAM, including full test compilation; screening 3 pairs, validation 15 pairs.
novelty: uncertain; established technique or active work
